findings.detail: Foreign currency symbols in the par/shares column were attributed to fair_value_currency even though the cost and fair value schedule columns are USD.

rationale: FX02 is a real row-level currency-unit defect. The raw schedule headers and totals present investment cost and fair value in dollars, including Total Investments after Cash Equivalents as $4,794,981 cost and $4,770,045 fair value. The cited position rows show the GBP symbol only before the par/shares amount; the cost and fair value amounts follow in the dollar-denominated cost/fair-value columns. The stored fair_value_currency value U_EUR is therefore not supported by the source and appears to come from misattributing the local par currency to fair value.
